# casdoor_role (Resource)

Manages a Casdoor role.

Only the attributes set in the configuration are written to Casdoor. The other fields of the object, including the ones not listed here, keep their current values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "casdoor_role" "admins" {
  owner        = casdoor_organization.acme.name
  name         = "admins"
  display_name = "Admins"
  users        = ["acme/alice"]
  is_enabled   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the role, unique within its owner.
- `owner` (String) The organization that the object belongs to.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description.
- `display_name` (String) The display name.
- `domains` (List of String) The domains.
- `groups` (List of String) The groups of the role, in the `organization/group` format.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the role is enabled.
- `roles` (List of String) The sub-roles inherited by the role, in the `organization/role` format.
- `users` (List of String) The users of the role, in the `organization/user` format.

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (String) The time when the role was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of the role in the `owner/name` format.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the organization and the name.
terraform import casdoor_role.example <organization>/<name>
```
